name: Built-In AI Browser
subtitle: The built-in AI APIs on iOS, on device
description: Built-In AI Browser, a web browser for iOS with the built-in AI APIs (Prompt, Summarizer, Writer, Rewriter, Translator, and Language Detector) backed by Apple Foundation Models, or by Gemma 4 on devices without Apple Intelligence.

apps.name: Built-In AI Browser
apps.subtitle: The built-in AI APIs on every page
apps.localizedDescription:
An experimental web browser for iOS where every web page can use LanguageModel (the Prompt API), Summarizer, Writer, Rewriter, Translator, and LanguageDetector, with inference on the device.

On devices with Apple Intelligence the APIs use Apple Foundation Models. Elsewhere they use Gemma 4 E2B, downloaded once on first use (2 to 2.6 GB) and shared by all sites.

This is a personal experiment, and not an official Google product.

versions.localizedDescription: First AltStore release, tested on an iPhone 11 Pro Max, where Gemma runs text prompts on the GPU, and image and audio prompts on the CPU. Answers that stop when you switch apps continue when you come back.
